description: Installation of an external staircase to be used as a fire escape from the first floor flat to the shared garden path.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Existing Floorplan 1st floor received: 10/10/2018. Location Plan and Block Plan received: 12/10/2018. Unnumbered existing side elevation received: 12/03/2019. Proposed Side Elevation received: 19/03/2019. Unnumbered existing rear elevation, and Unnumbered proposed rear elevation received: 25/03/2019. Unnumbered existing ground floor plan, unnumbered proposed ground floor plan, and unnumbered proposed first floor plan, received: 24/04/2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
